deprecated: A `calendar` call whose arguments all fold is a constant in every position, so the compiler refuses this program ([LTIM.14.3]). compiler/LTIM.14.3_a_literal_call_with_no_value_is_refused covers the case.
scenario: [LTIM.14.3]: outside a `const`, the engine evaluates a calendar call when the rule runs, and a call that raises raises there. The call here has only LITERAL arguments, `calendar.date(2026, 2, 30)`, no day of 2026, in a rule's `where` rather than a `const`: the program must compile (no DS_VALIDATE_CONST_NOT_FOLDABLE, no other refusal), and when the rule runs the call raises [LTIM.14.2]'s ComputationError of kind DOMAIN and the activation is abandoned. Each rule's `where` is `t.id == N and <the call> != <a constant>`: for the other fact `t.id == N` is false and absorbs nothing to raise ([LNUL.4.2]), so fact 1 raises from one node and its fault is one fault fact ([LERR.9.2]), which `trapped` logs by kind. The control, fact 2, is `calendar.date(2024, 2, 29)`, a leap day, also all literals: `leap_day` fires and logs `built 2`, so a compiler that dropped or mis-folded literal calendar calls fails on it. Break tests: a compiler that folds the raising call outside a `const` refuses the program, or replaces the call with a value, and the DOMAIN line is missing; a runtime that evaluates the call at load, not when the rule runs, refuses the load; either way the vector fails. PATH PINNED: the compiler's `dsc.validate` asks `ltim_14_3_raising_calls` only of a `const`, and `dsc.rete` lowers the call unfolded to FN_CALENDAR_DATE; at run time, libds `adapter_ds_calendar_date`'s range check (`calendar_days`, rete/adapters.c) and Mercury `ds.chrono.ltim_14_2_date` (`ltim_14_2_day_in_range`) raise.
rules_ds:
import calendar

schema T scope logical:
    id: Int key

rule literal_not_a_day:
    T t where t.id == 1 and calendar.date(2026, 2, 30) != calendar.date(1970, 1, 1)
->
    log info "built 1"

rule leap_day:
    T t where t.id == 2 and calendar.date(2024, 2, 29) != calendar.date(1970, 1, 1)
->
    log info "built 2"

rule trapped:
    ComputationError c
->
    log info "{c.kind}"
